record.title: Evaluate derived native observer for physical capability verification
record.intent: Define the exact evidence required after signed-APK-preserving deployment.
requirements: Specify full Sparrow UI, identity, option persistence, signed APK invariance, standalone loaded native hash and cached18/18 checks across normal reboot, plus rollback to original APK-backed loading on failure.
Keep physical deployment behind ordinary-option persistence and stored baseline; retain the distinction between software capability and measured1GHz analog response.
acceptance: The physical capability verification contract is concrete.
